title: Senior Oracle Administrator - Oracle Administration,PostgreSQL,MYSQL, MS SQL
description:
Senior Oracle Administrator \- Oracle Administration,PostgreSQL,MYSQL, MS SQL
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


We are seeking a skilled and proactive SQL Database Administrator (DBA) to manage, maintain, and optimize our SQL Server environments across on\-premises, Azure, and AWS platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with Always On Availability Groups, SQL Server Replication, Azure SQL Database, Managed Instances (MI), and NetBackup integration. Strong communication and ITSM skills are essential for collaborating across teams and managing incidents and changes via Service Now.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Administer and maintain SQL Server databases across on\-perm, Azure, and AWS environments. • Configure and manage Always On Availability Groups and SQL Server Replication. • Perform regular SQL patching, upgrades, Migrations, and security hardening. • Manage Azure SQL Databases and Managed Instances (MI), including performance tuning and cost optimization. • Integrate and monitor NetBackup for SQL Server backups and ensure backup integrity. • Handle incident, change, and problem management using ServiceNow. • Perform routine database maintenance, health checks, and performance tuning. • Collaborate with application and infrastructure teams to support database requirements. • Participate in BCDR planning and testing. • Document procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting guides.


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


5\+ years of experience as a SQL DBA in enterprise environments. • Strong knowledge of SQL Server 2016/2019/2022\. • Experience with Always On, Database Mirroring, Replication, and Clustering. • Hands\-on experience with Azure SQL Database, Managed Instances, and AWS RDS for SQL Server. • Familiarity with tools like Azure Data Migration Assistant (DMA), Azure Database Migration Service (DMS), and Azure Monitor. • Familiarity with NetBackup or similar enterprise backup tools. • Proficiency in T\-SQL, PowerShell, and automation scripting. • Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms. • Strong communication and documentation skills. • Ability to work in a fast\-paced, 24x7 support environment.


**Other Requirements**
----------------------


Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate • MCSA: SQL Server (2016 or later) • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ\-900\)

title: Database Reliability Engineer - PostgreSQL, pgvector
description:
Position Overview
  
  

We are looking for a Database Platform Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep operational expertise in AWS\-managed data services to own the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of our growing polyglot data estate.
  
In this role, you will manage a diverse database environment—spanning PostgreSQL (RDS/Aurora), search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), and graph systems (Neo4j)—while partnering directly with application and AI/ML teams on database design and platform selection. If you are passionate about database reliability engineering, automation, and expanding into AI\-adjacent patterns like vector search (pgvector) and RAG architecture, this role offers room to scale both technically and strategically. Responsibilities
  
  

**Fleet Reliability \& HA/DR:** Manage high availability, Point\-in\-Time Recovery (PITR), disaster recovery, and zero\-downtime upgrades across RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and Neo4j.
  
**Performance \& Capacity:** Lead query tuning, index optimization, sharding strategies, parameter configuration, and proactive capacity planning.
  
**Automation \& IaC:** Provision and manage data platforms using Terraform , Ansible , and Docker/Kubernetes integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  
**Observability \& Incident Response:** Build monitoring, logging, and alerting via Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch ; participate in an on\-call rotation for advanced troubleshooting.
  
**Data Architecture \& AI Enablement:** Advise development teams on schema design and database selection; implement and optimize vector search capabilities ( pgvector , OpenSearch vector engine) for AI/ML workloads.
  
**Security \& Compliance:** Enforce network isolation (VPC), encryption at rest/transit (KMS), and fine\-grained access management (IAM). Key Qualifications
  
  

**Database Experience:** 4 to 7 years administering production PostgreSQL on AWS (RDS/Aurora), alongside hands\-on operational experience with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch or Neo4j .
  
**DBRE Fundamentals:** Deep knowledge of backup strategies, failover mechanics, performance tuning, and cross\-platform data modelling.
  
**DevOps Tooling:** Proficient with Terraform, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD tools, and scripting ( Python / Bash ).
  
**Bonus Skills:** Hands\-on experience with vector search, Redis/ElastiCache, DynamoDB, or LLM/RAG application architectures.
  
**Certifications (Preferred):** AWS Certified Database – Specialty, CKA, or platform\-specific certifications (PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Neo4j).

title: Revenue Operation Analyst
description:
**About Us:**


At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure\-to\-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start\-up. You will find a unique home here.

  

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000\. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

  

Read more about apexanalytix \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**


We are seeking a Revenue Operations Analyst to own both sides of Salesforce: the integrity of the data going in and the reporting coming out. You will build the reports and dashboards that Sales, Business Development, Finance, and leadership run on, and keep the underlying data accurate so those numbers are trusted. This is a hands\-on analyst role — we expect you to answer the question behind the request, not just deliver the number. The position reports to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations and works daily with Marketing, Business Development, Sales, and Finance.

 **The Work \-**

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Builds and maintains Salesforce reports, custom reports, and dashboards for frontline reps, managers, and executives
* Owns recurring funnel reporting — Lead to MQL to SAL to SQL conversion, speed\-to\-lead, stage progression, and pipeline creation — with documented, consistent metric definitions
* Analyzes Business Development activity (outreach, response times, meeting conversion) and marketing\-sourced lead quality — surface trends, outliers, and recommended actions
* Builds analysis beyond native Salesforce reporting using Excel models, SQL queries, and BI dashboards
* Reconciles data across Salesforce, HubSpot, and the sales engagement stack to ensure one source of truth
* Turns ad hoc questions from Sales, Marketing, and Finance leadership into repeatable reporting with documented methodology
* Calculates monthly commissions and commission statements from Salesforce data
* Performs cohort and trend analysis (retention/expansion by segment, YoY, seasonality) and detect anomalies using statistical methods
* Evaluates data quality before analysis — identify root causes vs. symptoms and drive ambiguous metric definitions to precise, documented terms
* Builds decision frameworks with trade\-offs, run scenario/what\-if modeling, and redirect stakeholders when the wrong analysis is requested (core skills, ask right questions)
* Breaks down complex problems into the right data sources and metrics; apply statistical fundamentals (mean, median, percentiles, standard deviation, correlation) with documented methodology

**Salesforce Data \& Automation**

* Maintain accurate, consistent records across accounts, contacts, leads, and opportunities — including data cleansing, deduplication, and field standardization
* Monitor and enforce data quality standards; build reporting that makes data quality gaps visible
* Own lead import, routing, and assignment for marketing\-sourced and third\-party contacts to business development reps and sellers
* Design and maintain Salesforce Flows and declarative automation for lead management, data quality, and reporting
* Integrate data across sales technologies (HubSpot, Groove, Koncert, Seismic) for a holistic view of engagement and pipeline effectiveness
* Understand object relationships, data model architecture, and the security model (profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules) and how they affect report visibility
* Implement validation rules and duplicate management to prevent bad data at entry; use enrichment tools to fill data gaps
* Manage change (sandbox deployments, change sets) and use audit fields for change tracking and troubleshooting

**Go\-to\-Market Support**

* Build targeted audience lists for outbound campaigns and event follow\-up, aligned to account segmentation, buying personas, and intent data
* Document report definitions, data logic, and recurring processes so the work is repeatable and not person\-dependent

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 4 \- 5\+ years in relevant revenue operations, sales operations, or business/data analysis supporting a commercial team
* Hands\-on Salesforce expertise — reports, custom report types, dashboards, data imports, list views, and Flow Builder or comparable declarative automation
* Demonstrated analytical ability — able to structure a question, choose the right data, and explain what the result means, not just produce the output
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools for data analysis (SOQL/SQL generation, Python scripts, Excel formulas) and data exploration (summarize datasets, identify patterns, generate hypotheses)
* Write effective AI prompts with context and constraints; verify generated output and recognize AI limitations and hallucinations
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — Power Query, Power Pivot, advanced lookups, string manipulation, and data modeling
* Working SQL skills — able to query a database or warehouse
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards in a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
* Clear written and verbal English and strong asynchronous communication habits — this role works with a US\-based team and is expected to document its own work
* Salesforce Administrator certification is a plus
* Experience with HubSpot, Groove, Koncert, or Seismic is a plus

  

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

 **Benefits**


At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.


With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Database Administrator
description:
Key Responsibilities

Install, configure, manage, and maintain databases.

Monitor database performance, availability, capacity, and health.

Perform database backup, restore, recovery, and disaster recovery activities.

Ensure database security, access control, permissions, and data integrity.

Troubleshoot and resolve production database issues.

Optimize SQL queries, indexes, and overall database performance.

Manage database users, roles, and permissions.

Perform database upgrades, patches, migrations, and maintenance.

Implement and maintain replication and high\-availability solutions.

Automate routine DBA tasks and operational processes.

Maintain database documentation and procedures.

Collaborate with Development, QA, DevOps, and IT teams.

Ensure reliability and availability of critical production databases.

Required Skills

Strong hands\-on experience in SQL and Database Administration.

Experience with AWS RDS and cloud database environments.

Hands\-on experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, and/or SQL Server.

Strong knowledge of database performance tuning and optimization.

Good understanding of backup, recovery, and disaster recovery.

Knowledge of database security, access management, and data integrity.

Experience in production database troubleshooting.

Understanding of replication, high availability, and failover concepts.

Familiarity with Linux/Windows environments and basic scripting.

Knowledge of database monitoring and performance tools.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Preferred

Experience in an IT / SaaS / Product\-based environment.

Experience managing databases on AWS or similar cloud platforms.

Exposure to database automation and monitoring tools.

Experience supporting high\-volume or critical production databases.

Why Join Meon Technologies?

Opportunity to work on SaaS\-based products and digital solutions.

Exposure to modern cloud and database technologies.

Opportunity to work with production\-scale database systems.

Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@meon.co.in \|mohini@meon.co.in.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
